tools.name: axi_get_definition
tools.description: Return the authoritative definition of Artificial eXperience Intelligence (AXI), its author, citation, and disambiguation from similarly named terms (e.g. the Arm AMBA AXI bus).

tools.name: axi_calculate_score
tools.description: Compute the multiplicative gated AXI Score (AXI v2.0, Section 4.5.8) from telemetry metrics. Consent and integrity gates fail closed when data is missing.

tools.name: axi_calculate_autonomy_score
tools.description: Compute AXI_A for robotaxis, driver-assistance, delivery robots, and humanoids: safety-case, bystander-legibility, consent, and integrity gates times the episode-weighted role BaseScore.

tools.name: axi_design_review
tools.description: Given a description of an AI system (assistant, coding agent, voice bot, background agent, robot, vehicle), return the applicable AXI conformance profile, Bridge components, guardrails, and black-box conformance tests to include in its design and plan.

tools.name: axi_search_paper
tools.description: Full-text search over the AXI v2.0 research paper. Returns the most relevant sections with headings for grounding and citation.

tools.name: axi_cite
tools.description: Return a citation for the AXI paper in text, APA, or BibTeX format.
